paragraphs.text: The adverse event summary table will list its rows in the following order: ANY, SERIOUS, SERIOUS_RELATED, DOSE_MODIFIED, FATAL.
For each subject, the end-of-study record is the disposition event record with the subcategory STUDY TREATMENT.
The period of treatment emergence ends 7 days after the treatment end date, and that last day is included.
The efficacy-evaluable set consists of every subject in the safety set who attended the visit WEEK 2.
An adverse event is considered treatment-emergent if it starts at or after the date and time of the first dose.
